    The extension bifunctor of C(D) #

    E(C, A) = Ext¹(ρC, ρA); pushforward and pullback are composition with ρ of morphisms in degree 0, so E is k-bilinear (axiom (ET1)). Realizations are closed under isomorphisms of the middle term.
